the limit shapes of two and three dimensional diagrams distributed according to Plancherel and Richardson statistics are the same as those obtained from the asymptotic representation of the corresponding symmetric group.
the limit shape for the three-dimensional diagrams is not a cone, as it is for the diagrams in two dimensions.
